_description: Cross-layer risk-tier contract vectors. Consumed by BOTH tests/test_risk_tier_contract.sh (bash, scripts/lib/risk-scoring.sh) and insights-rules/tests/test_risk_tier_contract.py (Python, plugins/risk_scoring.py). Any divergence fails CI.
_why: M-14: the two layers previously used different models (count-based vs weighted) while printing the same CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW vocabulary, and disagreed on 3 of 4 representative cases in BOTH directions. This file is the mechanism that makes re-divergence impossible -- it mirrors the proven shared/driver-verdict-test-vectors.json pattern.
_format: Each case is a set of findings expressed the way the BASH layer sees them (severity + gate + kcs). The Python harness maps gate -> domain via risk-scoring.json's gate_domains so both layers score identical inputs. expected_score is in centi-points (score x 100) and must match exactly -- integer bash math and float Python math agree because every weight is exact to 2dp.
